email_messages.subject: Tenure-Track Faculty Onboarding – Payroll/Benefits Steps to Include in Welcome Packet
email_messages.body:
Hi David and Monica,

I’m updating the onboarding workflow and welcome packet for newly hired tenure-track faculty (starting this summer). Can you confirm the required payroll/HR actions we need to communicate so the faculty member can be paid on time and enroll in benefits without delays?

Specifically:
1) Are new TT faculty paid through payroll (vs. stipend), and what are the must-do items before their start date?
2) What items must be completed in person vs. in the HR portal?
3) When do you recommend benefits enrollment occur, and what support is available (orientation/1:1 consult)?

Thanks—trying to keep our steps consistent across colleges.

Best,
Aisha Rahman
University Graduate Program Coordinator
Eastport University

email_messages.subject: Re: Tenure-Track Faculty Onboarding – Payroll/Benefits Steps to Include in Welcome Packet
email_messages.body:
Hi Aisha,

Confirming for tenure-track faculty:

• Payment method: They are paid via university payroll (not stipend).

• Items to complete in advance (HR Portal):
  – Direct deposit setup
  – Federal/state tax withholding elections (W-4 equivalents)

These portal items should be done before the start date so Payroll can issue the first check without manual intervention.

• Item requiring in-person completion: 
  – Form I-9 must be completed in person during check-in (with original acceptable documents). We do not accept remote verification for standard faculty hires.

Once the I-9 is completed and the portal items are in place, Payroll can pay compliantly and on schedule.

Monica can speak to benefits timing, but from a Payroll perspective the above three are the critical path.

Regards,
David Chen
Payroll Manager
Eastport University

email_messages.subject: Re: Tenure-Track Faculty Onboarding – Payroll/Benefits Steps to Include in Welcome Packet
email_messages.body:
Hi Aisha,

Adding benefits guidance for the welcome packet/onboarding workflow:

• Benefits enrollment timing: Our preference is that new tenure-track faculty complete benefits enrollment during their first week. This aligns with plan eligibility timelines and helps avoid retroactive corrections.

• How they enroll / support available:
  – They should attend Faculty Orientation (Benefits segment covers medical/dental/vision, retirement, and deadlines).
  – We strongly recommend they schedule a 1:1 benefits consultation with HR Benefits during that first week (especially if they have dependents or are transferring coverage).

Putting it together, the “must do” HR/payroll actions to avoid pay/coverage delays are:
1) Complete direct deposit + tax withholding in the HR portal before arrival (so Payroll can run the first payroll cleanly).
2) Complete the I-9 in person at check-in with original documents (to ensure compliant employment verification).
3) Enroll in benefits in week one via Orientation + 1:1 consult (to keep coverage effective dates and deductions on schedule).

If you want, I can send the standard language we use in offer/onboarding emails.

Best,
Monica Hayes
HR Benefits & Onboarding
Eastport University
